report:
## Conclusion

The best current evidence supports your skepticism: **hypnosis has not been shown to be reliably effective for smoking cessation.** While it isn't necessarily useless, rigorous trials fail to demonstrate that it works better than other methods or no treatment at all.

## The Evidence

The most authoritative source is the **Cochrane systematic review** (Barnes et al., 2019), which analyzed 14 randomized controlled trials involving 1,926 participants. Its conclusion is unambiguous: there is **"insufficient evidence to determine whether hypnotherapy is more effective for smoking cessation than other forms of behavioural support or unassisted quitting."** The review notes that if any benefit exists, it is likely small at most, and importantly, the impressive claims from uncontrolled/observational studies of hypnotherapy were **not confirmed** when tested in properly randomized trials (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6568235/).

This aligns with guidance from the **U.S. National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH)**, a government body that evaluates complementary therapies. Their public health guidance states plainly: **"There isn't enough evidence to show whether hypnosis is more effective for smoking cessation than other types of support or quitting on your own"** (https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/quitting-smoking).

A more recent 2023 meta-analytic review in *Frontiers in Psychology* examined five reviews (including three Cochrane reviews) and found that of six reported effect comparisons, only two reached statistical significance — reinforcing that evidence for hypnosis remains weak and inconsistent (https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2023.1330238/full).

**Bottom line:** Your instinct is well-supported by rigorous evidence. Hypnosis is not proven to help people quit smoking any more effectively than other approaches or quitting unaided, though methodological limitations in existing trials mean small effects can't be fully ruled out.
